effects.description: When Awakened, gain 1 Exalted Attack for every spirit matching this Fairy's origin. Gain 3 Initiative.
In the Awakening Phase, you may discard a rune to gain an Enchanted Attack.
While you are not Evil and have no Cursed Spirits, gain 5 Initiative and take 2 less damage.
Drop your status to Fallen; this counts as one corruption (Barrier restored, sacrifice as usual). Replace all Spirit World spirits with a random Arcane Abyss Spirit. Gain 2 Initiative.
For every unique Relic you hold, reduce incoming damage by 2.
Your side may always attack at the same time as the enemy. When discarded, gain 1 Enchanted Attack.
When you navigate to the Mountain Region from a different location, you may gain 1 Spirit Augment of your choice.
You may do ALL location interactions up to two times.
In Combat, deal 1 damage per Broken Barrier (max 4)
When you cultivate, you may discard 4 attack dice to gain 1 Arcane Attack Dice.
In the Awakening Phase, Gain 1 VP. If you are evil, you must discard this spirit.
When you encounter a player, you may give them and yourself 1 Fairy Relic from the supply.
If you Cultivate with 3 Heroes, gain 1 Spirit Augment. When discarded, gain 1 Enchanted Attack.
If you overkill by 2 damage, gain 1 Max Barrier. If you don't kill, gain 1 Enchanted Attack.
In the Awakening Phase, gain 1 VP.
When you Take Damage, you may choose to take 0 damage if you discard a relic.
When you gain an Exalted Attack Dice, you may gain 1 more. The extra dice does not cause this ability again.
Before you roll in combat, you may discard attack dice. For each dice that you discard, deal 2 more damage.
On awaken, for each Beast that you have, gain 1 rune of the origin of that Beast.
When you gain a Spirit Augment, you may gain 1 more of your choice. The extra augment does not cause this ability again.
In combat with a player who has more attack dice than you, strike first and deal 3 more damage.
Gain 2 initiative. On this spirit's Awakening, gain 3 Arcane Attack Dice.
You may initiate Monster Combat two times.
If the opponent has higher initiative, when you Take Damage, half it (rounding up).
+4 Initiative. If initiative is tied, your side strikes first.
When you Take Damage, take 1 less for every Water Spirit.
On Navigation Reveal, you may change your destination and you may always attack first.
When you take damage, take 6 less. Gain 6 damage and 6 Initiative.
In the Awakening Phase, if you are Evil, gain 1 Enchanted Attack Dice.
On awaken, gain 2 Spirit Augments of your choice. In the Location Phase, you may do one Spirit Augment trade from any location.
In the Awakening Phase, if you are not Evil and all your spirits are awakened, gain 1 VP.
When an Evil player or a monster attacks you, your side strikes first and deals 3 more damage.
You may pay your runes as runes of any type.
On Cultivate, gain 2 Max Barrier.
When you gain an attack dice, gain 1 Exalted Attack Dice.
When you enter a location where you were not last round, gain 2 Basic Attack Dice.
When you strike first, deal 2 more damage.
In combat with a monster, deal 5 more damage.
When you navigate to the Mountain Region from a different location, choose one: restore 3 Barrier, gain 3 Max Barrier, or gain 3 Basic Attack Dice.
In combat, roll again each attack dice that shows 0, once.
In a round when another player is at your location, gain 3 Initiative.
When you awaken a spirit, restore 3 Barrier and gain 1 Max Barrier.
At the start of combat with a player, take the best attack dice of that player for this combat.
When you become Corrupted, sacrifice 1 fewer spirit and gain 1 VP.
When you deal damage to a player, restore the same quantity of Barrier.
When you take damage, if your Barrier is full, take 3 less.
In the Awakening Phase, if you are not Evil, restore 2 Barrier.
